page.overview:
Who is Anton Orlov?

Anton Orlov was a Russian arms dealer who arrived to bid on Eli Mills and Gunnar Eversoll's auction at the Lockwood Manor. According to Eversoll, he was particularly interested in carnivores. He planned to pit them together in a $5,000 a seat pay-per-view cage match.

When Eversoll unveiled the Indoraptor, Orlov was the first person to bid on him and in fact won the auction. However, he fled with the other Lockwood guests when Owen Grady released the Stygimoloch "Stiggy" into the auction room. As the Indoraptor was later killed in battle with Blue, Orlov never did receive his prized predator. It is unknown if he bid on - or won - any other carnivores, however.
